applicant_file_summary: Home loan application with four documents (bank statement, employment letter, ID, salary slip from March) all currently unreadable due to file format issues; applicant identity and income details remain unverified.
criteria: FOIR (EMI to net monthly income ratio) at or below 50%
Borrower name consistent across all documents
Loan account number consistent across all documents
EMI stated in at least two independent documents and reconciled
EMI schedule totals arithmetically reconcile to stated values
Loan statement totals arithmetically reconcile to stated values
Salary slip gross, deductions, and net pay arithmetically consistent

documents.name: bank_statement.txt
extract: average monthly balance or net credit flow
any EMI or loan repayment references

watch_for: Applicant name spelling and consistency across ID, employment letter, bank statement, and salary slip
Net monthly salary from slip vs. stated income in employment letter vs. bank deposits
Any mention of existing EMI or loan obligations across documents
Salary slip deduction totals and net pay arithmetic
Employment letter salary vs. actual salary slip amounts (may indicate variable pay or bonus structure)
missing_expected: Loan sanction letter or loan statement (required to calculate EMI and verify FOIR)
Property documents or title deed (standard for home loan collateral verification)
Multiple salary slips (at least 2–3 months recommended to establish income stability)
Proof of other liabilities or existing loans (for full FOIR calculation)
